concepts.definition: A voluntary, confidential process in which a neutral mediator helps the parties reach their own agreement.
A process in which a neutral arbitrator decides a dispute, usually with a binding award.

questions.q: What is the main difference between mediation and arbitration?
questions.a: A mediator helps the parties decide, an arbitrator decides.

questions.q: What does the Singapore Convention on Mediation do?
questions.a: It lets parties enforce international commercial settlements from mediation in states that have joined it.
